%% ============================================================
%%  ats-resume-crafter — Resume Template (Gold Standard)
%%  Navy sidebar + azure accents + optional company logos
%%  Generated by Claude Code from brain/person.md
%%  Compile: pdflatex resume_latest.tex
%% ============================================================
%%
%%  This file is OVERWRITTEN on every run.
%%  Do not edit manually — edit brain/person.md and regenerate.
%%
%%  Robustness notes (keep these behaviours when regenerating):
%%  - \sideskill wraps its whole group in an unbreakable minipage,
%%    so a category label can never be orphaned at a page bottom
%%  - \sidesection uses \\* to keep headings with their content
%%  - Title cells in \explentry/\edulentry are ragged-right, so a
%%    wrapped title never justify-stretches
%%  - Photo and logos degrade gracefully: if the file is absent,
%%    the layout reserves the space and compiles cleanly
%%
%% ============================================================

%% ── Colours (Azure palette) ──────────────────────────────────
\definecolor{azure}{RGB}{70, 128, 196}        % primary azure
\definecolor{azuredeep}{RGB}{40, 88, 148}      % deep azure — main-column headers/rules/bullets
\definecolor{azurebright}{RGB}{120, 176, 240}  % bright azure — sidebar rules/dots on navy
\definecolor{sidecolor}{RGB}{22, 36, 60}       % deep navy sidebar
\definecolor{sidetext}{RGB}{224, 230, 238}     % off-white sidebar text
\definecolor{sidesubtle}{RGB}{158, 174, 196}   % muted bluish-grey sidebar text
\definecolor{sidelinkblue}{RGB}{130, 185, 245} % sidebar links
\definecolor{mainbg}{RGB}{248, 250, 252}       % soft off-white page background
\definecolor{darkgray}{RGB}{16, 20, 26}        % body text (near-black)
\definecolor{medgray}{RGB}{92, 98, 106}        % meta (dates, company, location)
\definecolor{lightgray}{RGB}{205, 212, 222}    % light rule
\definecolor{linkblue}{RGB}{40, 88, 148}       % main-column links

%% ── Sidebar background ───────────────────────────────────────
\AddToShipoutPictureBG{%
  \AtPageLowerLeft{%
    {\color{sidecolor}\rule{0.327\paperwidth}{\paperheight}}%
  }%
}

\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, urlcolor=linkblue, linkcolor=linkblue, pdfborder={0 0 0}}

%% ── Two-column ratio ─────────────────────────────────────────
\columnratio{0.295}

%% ── Main column section headings (paracol-safe) ──────────────
\newcommand{\mainsection}[1]{%
  \vspace{9pt}%
  \noindent{\normalsize\bfseries\color{azuredeep}\MakeUppercase{#1}}%
  \vspace{-5pt}\par\noindent%
  {\color{azuredeep}\hrule height 0.5pt}%
  \vspace{5pt}%
}

%% ── Bullet lists ─────────────────────────────────────────────
\setlist[itemize]{
  leftmargin = 1.2em,
  itemsep    = 2pt,
  parsep     = 0pt,
  topsep     = 3pt,
  label      = {\textcolor{azure}{\small\textbullet}},
}

%% ============================================================
%%  MACROS — SIDEBAR
%% ============================================================

%% Oval headshot — skipped cleanly if assets/photo.jpg is absent
\newcommand{\ovalphoto}[1]{%
  \IfFileExists{#1}{%
    \begin{tikzpicture}
      \begin{scope}
        \clip (0,0) ellipse (1.0cm and 1.22cm);
        \node[inner sep=0] at (0,0){\includegraphics[width=2.0cm]{#1}};
      \end{scope}
      \draw[azurebright, line width=0.6pt] (0,0) ellipse (1.0cm and 1.22cm);
    \end{tikzpicture}%
  }{}%
}

%% \\* after headings = no page break between a heading and its content
\newcommand{\sidesection}[1]{%
  \vspace{8pt}%
  {\color{white}\footnotesize\bfseries\MakeUppercase{#1}}\\*[-2pt]%
  {\color{azurebright}\rule{\linewidth}{0.35pt}}\\*[4pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sidecontact}[1]{%
  {\color{sidetext}\footnotesize #1}\\[3.5pt]%
}

%% Consolidated Technical Skills block (Rule 7): bold white category + off-white comma list.
%% Whole group is an unbreakable minipage — a category label can NEVER be orphaned
%% at a page bottom (paracol ignores \\* penalties when splitting the sidebar).
\newcommand{\sideskill}[2]{%
  \par\noindent\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\raggedright%
  {\color{white}\footnotesize\bfseries #1}\\[1.5pt]%
  {\color{sidesubtle}\footnotesize #2}%
  \end{minipage}\par\vspace{6.5pt}%
}

\newcommand{\sidecertitem}[1]{%
  {\color{azurebright}\tiny\textbullet}\enspace{\color{sidetext}\footnotesize #1}\\[3.5pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sidelangitem}[2]{%
  {\color{white}\footnotesize\textbf{#1}}\enspace{\color{sidesubtle}\footnotesize #2}\\[3pt]%
}

%% ============================================================
%%  MACROS — MAIN COLUMN
%% ============================================================

\newcommand{\summaryblock}[1]{%
  {\small\setlength{\parskip}{4pt}#1}\vspace{4pt}%
}

%% Big square company logo for EXPERIENCE entries — sits to the LEFT of the
%% title/company block. Degrades to a blank reserved column if the file is
%% absent, so text alignment never shifts. Drop logo files into assets/
%% as logo_<name>.png (or .jpg).
\newlength{\logocol}\setlength{\logocol}{11mm}   % reserved logo-column width
\newlength{\logogap}\setlength{\logogap}{3pt}     % gap between logo and text
\newcommand{\complogobig}[1]{%
  \IfFileExists{../assets/#1.png}{%
    \includegraphics[height=11mm, width=\logocol, keepaspectratio]{../assets/#1.png}%
  }{%
    \IfFileExists{../assets/#1.jpg}{%
      \includegraphics[height=11mm, width=\logocol, keepaspectratio]{../assets/#1.jpg}%
    }{}%
  }%
}

%% \explentry{logoname}{title}{company}{dates}{location}
%% Title cell is ragged-right — wrapped titles never justify-stretch
\newcommand{\explentry}[5]{%
  \noindent%
  \makebox[\linewidth][l]{%
    \begin{minipage}[c]{\logocol}%
      \raggedright\complogobig{#1}%
    \end{minipage}%
    \hspace{\logogap}%
    \begin{minipage}[c]{\dimexpr\linewidth-\logocol-\logogap\relax}%
      \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X r@{}}
        \textbf{#2} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #4}\\[1pt]
        \textcolor{medgray}{\small\itshape #3} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #5}
      \end{tabularx}%
    \end{minipage}%
  }%
  \par%
  \nopagebreak[4]%
}

%% \edulentry{logoname}{degree}{school}{location}{dates} — same logo-left layout.
%% Keep degree lines short enough to wrap cleanly — drop parenthetical
%% annotations rather than let a line stretch.
\newcommand{\edulentry}[5]{%
  \noindent%
  \makebox[\linewidth][l]{%
    \begin{minipage}[c]{\logocol}%
      \raggedright\complogobig{#1}%
    \end{minipage}%
    \hspace{\logogap}%
    \begin{minipage}[c]{\dimexpr\linewidth-\logocol-\logogap\relax}%
      \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X r@{}}
        \textbf{#2} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #4}\\[1pt]
        \textcolor{medgray}{\small\itshape #3} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #5}
      \end{tabularx}%
    \end{minipage}%
  }%
  \par%
  \vspace{6pt}%
}

%% Selected-project row — Name (bold) + azure italic type tag, then one impact line
\newcommand{\projectentry}[3]{%
  \nopagebreak\noindent{\small\textbf{#1}\enspace{\color{azuredeep}\footnotesize\itshape#2}}\par%
  {\small #3}\par\vspace{4.5pt}%
}

%% Small uniform logo for ACHIEVEMENT rows — 6mm tall, centred in the logo column
\newcommand{\complogosm}[1]{%
  \IfFileExists{../assets/#1.png}{%
    \includegraphics[height=6mm, width=\logocol, keepaspectratio]{../assets/#1.png}%
  }{%
    \IfFileExists{../assets/#1.jpg}{%
      \includegraphics[height=6mm, width=\logocol, keepaspectratio]{../assets/#1.jpg}%
    }{}%
  }%
}

%% Achievement row — small centred icon left, text right, no bullets
\newcommand{\achieveentry}[2]{%
  \noindent%
  \makebox[\linewidth][l]{%
    \begin{minipage}[c]{\logocol}%
      \centering\complogosm{#1}%
    \end{minipage}%
    \hspace{\logogap}%
    \begin{minipage}[c]{\dimexpr\linewidth-\logocol-\logogap\relax}{\small #2}\end{minipage}%
  }\par\vspace{2pt}%
}
